caption: Diagram 10  Maximum span of floors
description: The image is a section drawing titled "Diagram 10 Maximum span of floors" in a green header band at the top. Beneath the band, at the left, the note reads "See para 2C23". The drawing depicts a section with two vertical elements, each labelled "Wall". The left wall is drawn as a thick mass bounded by several vertical lines, one of which is dashed, running down through it. The right wall is drawn more thinly, marked by a central dashed line. From the foot of the left wall a horizontal line labelled "Floor" runs toward the middle of the image and stops, and from the foot of the right wall a horizontal line labelled "Floor" runs toward the right edge of the image, with a small solid black rectangle at its junction with the wall. The space between the two walls represents the span of the floor. No dimensions or scale are shown.
